"What is this place...
  A whole town floating in the sky...

"Long ago, living things prospered under
  Yggdrasil's protection, and we Watchers
  lived in peace as its servants.

"But one day... darkness covered the sky,
  and calamity descended
  from the high heavens. Its name...

"The black sun that appeared on earth...
  It may signal Calasmos's revival...

"Calasmos is the name of the evil god
  who once cast the earth into hell.

"Luminary who commands Cetacea.
  Time is of the essence!!
  Please, come to the Elder at once!

"These must be the people of the sky
  the Seer spoke of.

"A black sun...? Wasn't it Erdwin's Lantern?
  Anyway, let's meet the Elder.
